schema.description:
Add a comment to an existing issue. Requests owner confirmation before
    executing. `repo_name` is the full `owner/repo` form.
schema.name: add_issue_comment

schema.description:
Create a new issue. Requests owner confirmation before executing.
    `repo_name` is the full `owner/repo` form. Pack the relevant context from
    the conversation into `body`.
schema.name: draft_github_issue

schema.description:
List the GitHub repositories the authenticated user can access, most
    recently updated first. Call this FIRST whenever you don't already know the
    exact `owner/repo` name you need — never guess a repository name.
schema.name: list_github_repositories

schema.description:
List issues for a repo. `repo_name` must be the full `owner/repo` form
    (e.g. 'owner/repo'). `state` is 'open', 'closed', or 'all'. Pull
    requests are excluded.
schema.name: list_repo_issues

schema.description:
List pull requests for a repo. `repo_name` must be the full `owner/repo`
    form (e.g. 'owner/repo'). `state` is 'open', 'closed', or 'all'.
schema.name: list_repo_pulls

schema.description:
Read the full description and context of one issue. `repo_name` is the
    full `owner/repo` form.
schema.name: read_issue_details

schema.description:
Read the full details of one pull request (title, state, body, branches,
    draft/mergeable flags). `repo_name` is the full `owner/repo` form.
schema.name: read_pr_details

schema.description:
Close (state='closed') or reopen (state='open') an issue. Requests
    owner confirmation before executing. `repo_name` is the full `owner/repo`
    form.
schema.name: update_issue_status
